description: This file defines the class Vtiger_DependencyPicklist which manages picklist dependencies in the vtiger CRM, including retrieval, saving, deleting dependencies, and checking for cyclic dependencies.

classes.name: Vtiger_DependencyPicklist
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing picklist dependencies within the vtiger CRM module.

methods.name: getDependentPicklistFields
methods.description: Retrieve dependent picklist fields for a specific module, returning source and target fields with labels.

methods.name: getAvailablePicklists
methods.description: Get available picklist fields for a module, returning a mapping of field names to labels.

methods.name: savePickListDependencies
methods.description: Save or update picklist dependency mappings for a module based on provided dependency map.

methods.name: deletePickListDependencies
methods.description: Delete existing picklist dependencies between a source and target field in a module.

methods.name: getPickListDependency
methods.description: Retrieve a dependency map between source and target fields for a module.

methods.name: getPicklistDependencyDatasource
methods.description: Fetch the dependency data source for picklist dependencies in a module.

methods.name: getJSPicklistDependencyDatasource
methods.description: Get JSON-encoded dependency data source for use in JavaScript.

methods.name: checkCyclicDependency
methods.description: Check for cyclic dependencies in picklist dependencies for a module.

methods.name: getDependentPickListModules
methods.description: Retrieve modules that have dependent picklists.
